market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $50,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at $76K needs to dip to $50K (a ~34% drop) sometime between now and Dec 31, 2026 (~8 months). With Bitcoin's roughly 60% annualized volatility and 8 months to play out, the probability of touching ~34% below spot at some point is moderately material — base-rate analysis suggests roughly 30-40%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Persistence of ETF inflows and whether macro risk-off accelerates a drawdown.
